description: This file defines the TransactionRepository class, which manages an in-memory list of MoneyTransaction objects, providing methods to retrieve, add, and seed sample transaction data for a personal expense tracker application.

classes.name: TransactionRepository
classes.description: A repository class for managing transactions in memory, including methods for retrieval, addition, and seeding sample data.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns an immutable list of all stored transactions.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new transaction to the store.

methods.name: seedSample
methods.description: Populates the store with sample income and expense transactions for preview purposes.
